android.desc:
Want to grow your social media account? The key is engagement—replying to posts, joining conversations, and staying active. But who has the time?

Meet Slopper, your secret weapon for social media growth.

Slopper uses a powerful floating bubble to help you generate countless high-quality, relevant replies in any app. Engage with 10x more posts on X (Twitter), Instagram, Reddit, and more.

Best of all, it runs 100% on your device. Your activity, selected text, and generated replies never leave your phone. No servers, no tracking, and no one else training on your data. Boost your engagement without ever sacrificing your privacy.

Key Features:
⬆︎ Boost Your Social Growth Stop missing conversations. The "reply guy" app for power users. Instantly generate relevant replies to tons of posts. Engaging with more people increases your visibility, boosts your account, and helps you build a community faster.

⬆︎ Total Privacy (100% On-Device AI) Unlike other AI tools that process your data in the cloud, Slopper works entirely offline. Your conversations are never seen by us or used for training. Grow your brand without feeding your data to third-party AI companies.

⬆︎ Deep Customization (Sound Like You) This isn't a generic bot. Create and manage custom tones (like 'Sarcastic', 'Supportive', or 'Expert') and edit prompt templates to ensure your high-volume replies always match your unique voice and brand.

⬆︎ Works Everywhere The floating bubble works seamlessly over any application. Use it on all your social media apps, chat clients (WhatsApp, Telegram), and email to maintain your engagement everywhere.

⬆︎ Context-Aware Actions Slopper provides smart defaults based on your context, such as "POST" actions for social media or "CHAT" actions for messaging apps, making you even faster.

Get Slopper Unlimited Upgrade to send as many private replies as you want and unlock the full power of prompt and tone customization.

Download Slopper today and start supercharging your social media engagement—privately.
